name: Cortivex
description: Cortivex is a targeted neuroinflammatory suppressant formulated for the specific pattern of microglial activation caused by prolonged BCI use. Unlike general anti-inflammatories, it selectively reduces inflammation in the cortical and subcortical regions most stressed by neural-digital interface activity without compromising the immune response elsewhere in the brain. Chronic BCI overuse without Cortivex leads to progressive neural degradation colloquially known as 'burnhead.'
effects: alleviation of interface headaches and cognitive fog
protection against long-term cortical thinning from chronic BCI stress
reduction of interface-site scar tissue formation in neural tissue
side_effects: mild cognitive dulling at high doses
reduced emotional intensity for 2–4 hours post-dose
in rare cases: suppression of beneficial neuroplasticity alongside harmful inflammation
dependency on drug for normal cognition in heavy BCI users
rebound inflammation if stopped suddenly after long-term use
cultural_context: Anyone who uses a BCI heavily — which is most of GLMZ's working population — needs Cortivex. Data workers, BCI-dependent laborers, and anyone in a high-interface job takes it as a matter of course. The moderate addiction risk isn't chemical but physiological: heavy BCI users' brains adapt to Cortivex's presence and become unable to manage inflammation without it. This has created a massive dependent population and a lucrative recurring revenue stream for Novafold. On the Shelf, where BCI work is brutal and poorly regulated, 'burnhead' is a genuine epidemic among those who can't afford consistent Cortivex.
story_hooks: Novafold's internal documents show they knew Cortivex creates physiological dependency within six months of heavy use — and deliberately calibrated the BCI integration protocols used by major employers to ensure users would reach that threshold.

A Shelf neighborhood is experiencing an outbreak of severe burnhead — someone has cut the local Cortivex supply with an inert compound, and the cognitive damage is beginning to affect the neighborhood's ability to function.
A researcher at Novafold has developed a one-time gene therapy that would eliminate BCI-induced inflammation permanently — and has disappeared after presenting the findings internally.
